title: weather_profile
description: EchoForge weather_profile document. Declares a named atmospheric / oceanic regime (cloud cover, rain rate, fog visibility, sea state, wind vector, refractivity profile + ducting layer height, temperature/pressure/humidity) used by the radar / EO-IR / acoustic chains to model propagation, attenuation, and clutter Doppler. Strict-open: ITU-R P.676 (gas), P.838 (rain), P.840 (cloud), P.453 (refractivity), Pierson-Moskowitz (sea-state spectrum), Beaufort scale (wind classification). MODTRAN-style band-integrated transmission for EO/IR. References: tips/problem_deep_dive/ on weather/clutter; tips/science_stack/current/ on propagation model.

display_name.description: Human-readable regime name (e.g. 'UAE Coastal Summer Clear', 'Ukraine Winter Snow Fog', 'Black Sea Autumn Moderate Duct', 'Gulf Monsoon Heavy Rain').

regime_class.description: Coarse classification useful for scenario selection.

oktas.description: Sky cover (0=clear, 8=full overcast). Per WMO Met Code 2700.

liquid_water_content_g_per_m3.description: Per ITU-R P.840-8 (cloud attenuation). Typical: thin cirrus 0.01, stratus 0.2-0.5, cumulus 0.5-1.0, cumulonimbus 1.0-3.0.

rain_rate_mm_per_h.description: Per ITU-R P.838-3. Drizzle <1, light 1-5, moderate 5-20, heavy 20-50, extreme >50.

rain_top_m_agl.description: Cloud-base or freezing-level top for rain layer.

rain_polarization_h_vs_v_ratio_db.description: H/V attenuation asymmetry (ITU-R P.838 k_h vs k_v) — usually ~1 dB at X-band 25 mm/h.

douglas_state.description: Douglas sea state (0=calm glassy ... 9=phenomenal). NATO/WMO standard.

wind_speed_u10_mps.description: Wind at 10 m reference height; drives Pierson-Moskowitz spectrum α·g²/ω⁵·exp(−β·(g/(U·ω))⁴).

sea_spike_kurtosis.description: Empirical fourth-moment ratio of clutter envelope; 3=Rayleigh, >5=K-distribution heavy-tail (Ward/Tough/Watts §2).

wind_vector_mps.description: Surface-level 3D wind vector (u east, v north, w up) at reference height (default 10 m AGL).

wind_profile_log_law_z0_m.description: Surface roughness length for boundary-layer log-law profile (m). Sea ~0.0002, grass ~0.03, urban ~1.0.

refractivity_profile.description: Per ITU-R P.453 N-unit refractivity. Modified refractivity M(h) = N(h) + 0.157·h enables bent-ray ducting modeling.

n_at_msl.description: Surface refractivity N-units. Temperate maritime ~330, dry continental ~280, tropical humid ~370.

gradient_n_per_km.description: dN/dh. Standard atmosphere ~−40; sub-refractive >−40; super-refractive [-150, -40]; trapping <−157 (ducting).

k_factor_earth.description: Effective-Earth-radius multiplier. Standard 4/3, ducting >2, super-refractive ~1.5, sub-refractive ~1.0.

evaporation_duct_height_m.description: Marine evaporation duct height — typically 5-40 m over warm sea.

eo_ir_transmission_bands.description: MODTRAN-style band-integrated transmission per (band, range_m, atmospheric_path). Used by EO/IR sensor archetypes.
